description: Decision 107 a (rewrite of the S4J-3 B2B rule): converter-station B2B (DC bus with exactly one DC link and one B2B: convert_599_890 at MY_Peninsular22 0, convert_412_577 at TH21 0) bidirectional, NOT extendable, efficiency 1, p_nom fixed at the DC link's extension limit (20300 MW = stock 300 + 20,000); no zero-cost capacity variable, no coupling equality (hook research_b2b_follows_dc withdrawn: the zero-cost variable + equality failed the solver-tolerance gates, S4J_STOP_01 section 7). Reasons: the converter-station cost is part of the DC link cost; a B2B fixed at the DC extension limit never binds before the DC link, so the feasible DC flows equal those of the S4J-3 form. Difference recorded: generation candidates at the two DC buses (CCGT / OCGT / FT duplicates of the AC-bus candidates, 34 MW offshore wind at CF 0.037; no load, no existing capacity) may now export up to 20,300 MW instead of 2,000 + the DC increment. Disconnected: the DC link is removed, the B2B keeps the S4H state. Other structures reported: PH_Visayas10 0 (structure differs from a converter station (one DC link + one B2B))

Decision 105 b: one-way DC links made bidirectional (Khlong Ngae – Gurun; p_min_pu 0 -> -1; with transmission_losses = pypsa_eur split into a lossy forward / reverse pair, without losses p_min_pu = -1)
Decisions 105 b, 107 a: research.network.th_my_hvdc = bidirectional_fixed_b2b (main) | s4h (S4H state: one-way Khlong Ngae - Gurun, B2B 2,000 MW; comparison, default when absent)
